scope: All23 October source acquisition/identity/immutability infrastructure only. age_policy: Exact timestamp-window replay passes the stored category fields. Semantics are only partially tightened by finite regexes; manual review found residual violations. Category labels do not certify semantic eligibility. Every actual cited company news/preview must be at most7days old, company result14days, and only macro release/current policy baseline may use35days.
limits: Retrieval-time historical Google search results are not original contemporaneous RSS vintages. Raw retrieval responses are archived and hash-bound.
Daily100result caps and search indexing/selection prevent exhaustive coverage; residual daily caps explicitly listed.
RSS pubDate can precede actual release; publisher canonical dates and article bodies were not independently resolved.
Finite headline semantics/release regexes may miss relevant names or conservatively remove previews; exact cited claims require own-date editorial timing/meaning review.
This infrastructure acceptance does not approve report prose, concrete numeric claims, causal interpretation or historical trade selection.

known_semantic_exclusions.scope: Manually identified stale company headline examples across own-date frozen feeds, not an exhaustive content review. Give authors only their own-date advice. Frozen IDs/bytes remain unchanged.
